messages:
maya: Heads-up, we need a concrete canary rollout policy for model v2 (upgrade). Goal: safe percent ramps + avoid thundering/warmup spikes. Current naive plan: 0.5% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%, 10m per step. Thoughts?

sam: Agree on cautious ramp, but 10m/step is risky on bursty traffic. Recommend randomizing assignments + jitter window so clients don't flip on boundaries. Early steps shorter (3-5m) and strict abort gates.

jing: Gate metrics: p95 latency, error rate (5xx + fallback rate), token-cost delta, and quality eval on golden prompts. Suggested aborts: error_rate > 0.5% absolute OR >2x baseline; p95 +150ms absolute OR >30% relative; quality drop >2%.

lucas: Console/API should expose: step_percent, step_duration, jitter_pct, overlap_seconds, gate_checks. Add per-step "hold" so operator can pause.

maya: Proposed YAML snippet:
```yaml
canary_id: model-v2-canary-2026-03
steps:
  - percent: 0.5
    duration_minutes: 3
  - percent: 1
    duration_minutes: 3
  - percent: 5
    duration_minutes: 10
  - percent: 20
    duration_minutes: 15
  - percent: 50
    duration_minutes: 20
jitter_pct: 20
overlap_seconds: 30
sticky_seed_minutes: 10
gate_checks:
  - name: error_rate
    threshold_absolute: 0.005
    threshold_relative: 2.0
  - name: p95_latency_ms
    threshold_absolute: 150
    threshold_relative: 1.3
  - name: eval_quality_drop_pct
    threshold_absolute: 2.0
auto_rollback: true
abort_reasons: [metric, quota, manual, infra]
```

sam: A few calls:
- use sticky_seed_minutes so a routed client stays on canary for N minutes
- consider alternate exponential ramp (0.5 -> 2 -> 8 -> 32 -> 100) for bursty workloads
- add smoothing window on routing decisions to avoid sawtooth

jing: Telemetry: every trace/span should include rollout_id, canary_step, bucket_seed and billing tags. Emit derived per-rollout metrics: p50/p95/error/token-cost aggregated per minute.

lucas: UI: show both absolute + relative thresholds with recommended defaults. Add "dry-run" that does routing but flags metrics separately (no public effect). Also show abort_reason prominently in the rollout timeline.

deploy-bot: :rotating_light: canary job created: model-v2-canary-2026-03 (id=cv2-1890012345). Watchers: @maya @sam @jing

maya: Also: quota rejections should be a separate abort_reason (quota) and surfaced differently (not as metric rollback). Console should show remediation steps.

sam: +1. Add abort_reason enum to API and recommended remediation messages.

jing: Agree. Also ensure billing tags get into cost pipeline so canary cost spikes are visible.

lucas: I'll add rollout_id and bucket tags to traces and update the cost pipeline. Will PR UI changes for new fields.

maya: Can we agree defaults? early durations 3m, jitter_pct 20, sticky_seed_minutes 10, auto_rollback true, abort_reasons include quota. If yes I'll land to canary-presets and ping ops when started.

sam: :thumbsup:

jing: :thumbsup:

lucas: :eyes: will follow up PR

maya: thanks — landing after PRs pass.
